description: This file defines the `GestureBuilderActivity` class for an Android application that manages gesture creation, editing, and storage. It provides UI interactions for loading gestures from storage, renaming, deleting, and displaying gesture thumbnails. It also handles asynchronous loading of gesture data and integrates with gesture libraries.

classes.name: GestureBuilderActivity
classes.description: Main activity for managing gestures: loading, displaying, renaming, and deleting gestures within the application's gesture library.

classes.name: GestureBuilderActivity.NamedGesture
classes.description: A simple data holder class linking a gesture's name with its Gesture object.

classes.name: GestureBuilderActivity.GesturesAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter to manage displaying gesture items with thumbnails and handling gesture data.

classes.name: GestureBuilderActivity.GesturesLoadTask
classes.description: AsyncTask for loading gestures from storage in the background, creating thumbnails, and updating the UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, adapter, and loads gestures.

methods.name: loadGestures
methods.description: Starts asynchronous background task to load gestures from storage.

methods.name: addGesture
methods.description: Starts activity to create a new gesture.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from gesture creation activity, reloads gestures if successful.

methods.name: renameGesture
methods.description: Opens dialog to rename a selected gesture.

methods.name: deleteGesture
methods.description: Removes the specified gesture from the library and updates the UI.

methods.name: createRenameDialog
methods.description: Constructs the dialog UI for renaming a gesture.

methods.name: changeGestureName
methods.description: Updates the gesture's name in the gesture library and refreshes the list.

methods.name: cleanupRenameDialog
methods.description: Dismisses and nullifies the rename dialog and current rename gesture reference.
